title: Harborline Server Range: Hardware and Network Specification
content:
The VPS and Dedicated Servers range has two server types. The four Harborline VPS tiers are virtual servers; Harborline Dedicated Standard and Harborline Dedicated Enterprise are dedicated machines. CPU cores are virtual on a VPS and physical on a dedicated machine. Storage is NVMe.

## Compute and storage

| Tier | Server type | CPU cores | Memory (GB) | NVMe storage (GB) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | VPS | 1 | 2 | 50 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | VPS | 2 | 4 | 100 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | VPS | 4 | 8 | 200 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | VPS | 8 | 16 | 400 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | Dedicated | 6 | 32 | 1000 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | Dedicated | 16 | 128 | 3840 |

## Network and addressing

| Tier | Network port speed (Gbps) | IPv4 addresses included | IPv6 range of prefix length 64 included | Volumetric DDoS mitigation included (Gbps) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | 1 | 1 | Yes | 10 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | 1 | 1 | Yes | 10 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | 1 | 1 | Yes | 10 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | 1 | 1 | Yes | 10 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | 1 | 1 | Yes | 20 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | 10 | 5 | Yes | 40 |

## Access and service targets

| Tier | Full root access | Out-of-band console and rescue mode | Elapsed hours targeted to replace failed hardware | Elapsed hours targeted from paid order to hand-over |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline VPS 2 GB | Yes | Yes | 0 | 1 |
| Harborline VPS 4 GB | Yes | Yes | 0 | 1 |
| Harborline VPS 8 GB | Yes | Yes | 0 | 1 |
| Harborline VPS 16 GB | Yes | Yes | 0 | 1 |
| Harborline Dedicated Standard | Yes | Yes | 4 | 72 |
| Harborline Dedicated Enterprise | Yes | Yes | 2 | 120 |

The hardware replacement target is 0 for every VPS tier. Both the hardware replacement figures and the hand-over figures are targets measured in elapsed hours.

## Reading the sheet

- A Harborline Dedicated Enterprise machine is the only tier with a 10 Gbps port and with more than one IPv4 address included.
- Moving from Harborline VPS 8 GB to Harborline VPS 16 GB doubles the cores, the memory and the storage on this sheet, while the port speed, the included IPv4 address and the DDoS mitigation capacity stay the same.
